respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture diagram represents Cybex's data processing and retrieval platform, separated into 'Data Ingestion' and 'Data Retrieval'. In data ingestion, raw trade data (CSV/Excel) is uploaded to Amazon S3, triggering an AWS Lambda function for validation. Validated data is stored in another S3 location, triggering a second AWS Lambda function that processes and indexes data into an Amazon OpenSearch cluster powered by Graviton2 instances. In data retrieval, users access the system via web or mobile. For the web app, requests hit an Angular front-end, returning assets to the browser which calls a Python back-end; mobile requests call the back-end directly. The back-end queries the data layer (Amazon OpenSearch and Amazon RDS) and returns results to the user. For reports exceeding 10,000 records, the back-end generates the report into an Amazon S3 bucket and sends a pre-signed URL notification to the user via Amazon SES.
respuesta.nombre: Cybex Trade Data Processing and Retrieval Architecture with OpenSearch
